name: webkit-wpt-status
description: Tracks how far WebKit's imported web-platform-tests have drifted from upstream WPT.

scripts.build: npm run collect:soft && npm run build:web
scripts.//collect:soft: Bakes a snapshot into the deployed image so the service has data the moment it boots, even if the runtime has no git. A failure here is survivable: the server retries on its refresh schedule.
scripts.collect:soft: node src/collect/index.js || echo '[build] collect failed; the server will retry at runtime'
